_comment: Stage-3 supplemental services: proven service docs generated from Azure/azure-rest-api-specs by the original AutoRest pipeline (ref/stackql-provider-azure-original), for Azure services with NO azure-sdk-for-python package. Keys are stackql service aliases; the yaml artifact for each lives at provider-dev/supplemental/<alias>.yaml. Injected AFTER stage 2 by provider-dev/scripts/add-supplemental-services.mjs (stage 3 must re-run after every stage-2 run - stage 2 wipes the provider trees). Retirement rule: when an azure-sdk-for-python package appears for one of these services, stage 3 hard-fails - remove the entry and artifact and let the SDK pipeline own it. `title`/`description` override the artifact's info block; `source`/`notes` are documentation only.

aad_domain_services.title: Microsoft Entra Domain Services
aad_domain_services.description: Managed domain services: domain join, LDAP, Kerberos and NTLM without deploying domain controllers (Microsoft.AAD).
aad_domain_services.notes: No azure-mgmt SDK package. Regenerate via ref/stackql-provider-azure-original: bin/stackql-azure-openapi {generate,dereference,combine,tag} domainservices.

blueprints.title: Azure Blueprints
blueprints.description: Blueprint definitions, artifacts and assignments for repeatable environment deployment (Microsoft.Blueprint; deprecated upstream in favor of Template Specs and Deployment Stacks).
blueprints.notes: Spec frozen upstream. Original pipeline spec-dir key: blueprint.

video_indexer.title: Azure AI Video Indexer
video_indexer.description: Extract insights from video and audio with AI: accounts, private endpoints and generation configuration (Microsoft.VideoIndexer).
